title: Social Systems
subtitle: Food riots, revolutions, ethnic violence, urban health, fads and panics arise from collective actions. Complex systems science provides new opportunities to understand these collective behaviors by describing the patterns of behavior of individuals interacting through social networks.
summary: Teams Society is facing a new and unprecedented challenge — responding to its own overwhelming complexity. The structure of our society must change.
